d: Short, honey-blonde hair with a voluminous, swept-back style and long bangs framing a youthful, mature face. Narrow, almond-shaped eyes in a pale golden-green hue. A slender build wearing a navy blue, form-fitting floor-length gown with a ribbed bodice and a white open-front blazer draped over the shoulders, accented by a large dark navy bow at the waist and a black choker with a gold charm. A small, dark navy tilted hat rests on the head, while the character holds a large bouquet of green foliage wrapped in brown paper and a tall, slender wooden staff topped with a silver crescent moon and floral ornaments.
